RebelCohorts.Best: %1$s, best: the new visitors of %2$s, where %3$s.
RebelCohorts.GridHelp: A row follows one cohort. A darker cell is a larger share of its new visitors. Click a row to draw that cohort in the chart.
RebelCohorts.HelpDay: A cohort is the visitors who came for the first time on the same day. See how many of them came back, or converted a goal, on the days after. A day that is not over is left out.
RebelCohorts.HelpMonth: A cohort is the visitors who came for the first time in the same month. See how many of them came back, or converted a goal, in the months after. A month that is not over is left out.
RebelCohorts.HelpWeek: A cohort is the visitors who came for the first time in the same week. See how many of them came back, or converted a goal, in the weeks after. A week that is not over is left out.
RebelCohorts.PickPeriod: Cohorts are by day, week or month. Pick one of them as the period.
RebelCohorts.RevenueHelp: Revenue is what a cohort has brought in for each of its new visitors, from the first visit up to and including each period.
